paragraphs.text: Masako (MAH-sah-koh) , the Humorless , was a Human Advisor of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War .

Masako was a stern noblewoman in Takeshi Konda ’s court. She acts as Konda's eyes and ears in Eiganjo Castle . As one of his closest advisors, she was known for her immaculate appearance and was said to be privy to a great many of Konda’s deepest secrets.
